Anya R: Heads-up — paging for EU-west embedding 5xx spike started 02:12 UTC, looks correlated with KV cache evictions. Incident opened: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1124 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1124 created by Anya R at 2026-03-15T02:15Z — Severity: P2. Pager notified: Sam P (primary), Leila K (secondary).

Sam P: I'm on it, joining bridge now. Quick check — are the eviction rates >50%? metrics look rough.

Leila K: Eviction rate peaked ~62% on nodes embedding-prod-eu-*. I see autoscaler triggered extra pods but they didn't attach fast enough.

Mike O: Confirmed 503s from our edge logs; request retry noise amplified latency. Customers with long prompt sequences affected.

Anya R: Main impact: embedding generation requests returning 503s and high p95. Customer-facing: some metadata search features degraded. No data loss.

Sam P: Short-term mitigation: scale up dedicated pool to add capacity and temporarily lower batching window. I'm applying a -replica override on embedding-pool-eu.

Leila K: Also increasing eviction-threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75 on the node group, and disabling aggressive compaction job for 30m. Runbook ref: /runbooks/kv-evictions (see step 3).

Sam P: Command I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference set resources deployment/embedding-pool-eu --limits=cpu=2000m,memory=14Gi
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/embedding-pool-eu --replicas=12
```
Scaling showed partial improvement after ~90s.

ops-bot: autoscaler:scaled embedding-pool-eu from 6 -> 12 (trigger: manual override) — 02:28 UTC

Leila K: Observability note: enable detailed cache-evict trace for 30m (config: cache.eviction.trace=true). I'll flip that; expect more log volume.

Sam P: Current status @ 02:35 UTC: 5xx rate down ~70% from peak; p95 latency dropping but still above SLO for EU-west. Leaving scaled pool in place until next shift.

Mike O: Customer impact: monitoring shows 4 customers with repeated errors in last 30m. CS notified and asked to hold deploys. I'll follow up with a mitigation summary for them.

Anya R: Next steps for morning shift: - Keep pool at 12 replicas for 1 hour, monitor eviction_rate and retry storms. - Leila to revert compaction change after 30m. - Sam to run postmortem checklist and collect top 5 trace ids.

Sam P: Primary for next shift: Leila K will take primary at 06:00 UTC, I hand off remaining items. Secondary: Mike O. Coverage gap: APAC region autoscaler still not tested under same load — add a small smoke test.

Leila K: Acknowledged. I'll run smoke test in APAC + verify runbook commands. Leaving targeted alerts: alert/kv_eviction_high -> escalate to oncall 1 if >10m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1124 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring. Updated severity -> P3 at 02:46 UTC.

Anya R: Handoff summary posted to #eng-oncall thread. Links: incident page, runbook, deploy logs. Good job team. :thumbsup:
